I'm scared, .
[ES] Se puso oscuro... No creo que Tiaran se sienta bien.

Tengo miedo, .

[EN] After playing with Anya, and the young girl encountered a small horde of agitated ghilliedhus.

The ghilliedhus were attempting to feed off of Tiaran's roots, until stopped them.
[ES] Tras jugar con Anya, y la joven se encontraron con una pequeña horda de ghilliedhus alterados.

Los ghilliedhus intentaban alimentarse de las raíces de Tiaran, hasta que los detuvo.

[EN] Oh, no! Ghilliedhus!

They're mean! They steal the sap from Tiaran's roots and it makes her sick!

You have to stop them, ! I'll go get Uncle Emun!"I'll stop them, Anya. You be careful!"
[ES] ¡Oh, no! ¡Ghilliedhus!

¡Son malos! ¡Le roban la savia a las raíces de Tiaran y la enferman!

¡Tienes que detenerlos,
! ¡Iré a buscar al tío Emun!"I'll stop them, Anya. You be careful!"

[EN] You just defeated three ghilliedhus pretty much by yourself, ! If I hadn't seen it, I wouldn't have believed it!

I wonder what they're doing here? We've never had ghilliedhus out on the island before..."How did they get here?"
[ES] ¡Acabas de derrotar a tres ghilliedhus casi tú solo, ! Si no lo hubiera visto, ¡no lo habría creído!

Me pregunto qué estarán haciendo aquí. Nunca antes habíamos tenido ghilliedhus en la isla..."How did they get here?"
